# God-Tier macOS Development Environment

> A reproducible, user-space macOS development environment using Mise as the central orchestrator. Strict hierarchy: Mise > Bun > Pixi > Uv. Zero system modifications - everything installs to ~/.local.

This project provides a complete development environment setup for macOS with AI-first tooling, modern CLI utilities, and reproducible configuration via Pkl/TOML.

---

### Essential Documentation
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/README.md): Setup guide with architecture overview

### Installation
```bash
cd ~/dev/github/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment
./setup.sh
```

## API Reference - Mise Tasks

All commands use `mise run <task>` format. Run `mise tasks` to list all available tasks.

### Environment Management
- **mise run validate**: Validate environment health (runs config/scripts/validate.sh)
- **mise run dashboard**: Launch unified TUI manager (requires pixi)
- **mise run help**: Show system manual (MANUAL.md in pager)
- **mise run lint**: Lint shell scripts with shellcheck

### Tool Management
- **mise run tools:status**: Show all tools and settings
- **mise run tools:install**: Install all configured tools
- **mise run tools:update**: Update all tools to latest versions
- **mise run tools:uninstall -- <tool>**: Uninstall specific tool
- **mise run tools:reinstall -- <tool>**: Reinstall specific tool
- **mise run tools:doctor**: Full environment health check

### Cloud Agents (SkyPilot)
- **mise run agent:check**: Verify AWS/cloud credentials are configured
- **mise run agent:up**: Launch cloud agent on AWS (CLUSTER=name to customize)
- **mise run agent:down**: Terminate cloud agent (CLUSTER=name or -- name)
- **mise run agent:status**: Show cloud agent status (CLUSTER=name for specific agent)
- **mise run agent:stop**: Stop cloud agent (Note: Spot instances cannot be stopped)
- **mise run agent:start**: Start stopped cloud agent (Note: Spot instances cannot be stopped/restarted)
- **mise run agent:restart**: Restart cloud agent (Note: Spot instances cannot be stopped)
- **mise run agent:ssh**: SSH into cloud agent
- **mise run agent:logs**: View cloud agent logs
- **mise run agent:exec**: Execute command on agent

### macOS Setup
- **mise run setup-mac**: Configure macOS system defaults
- **mise run setup-mcp**: Configure mise MCP for Claude Desktop
- **mise run setup-extensions**: Install GitHub Copilot extension
- **mise run setup:auto**: Auto-detect platform, run appropriate setup
- **mise run setup:macos**: macOS-specific setup
- **mise run setup:container**: Container/DevPod setup
- **mise run setup:linux**: Linux (non-container) setup

### Validation
- **mise run validate:rules**: Check for anti-patterns and rule violations
- **mise run validate:tools**: Check for tool shadowing issues

### Environment Status
- **mise run env:status**: Show comprehensive environment status

---

## Configuration

### Core Configuration Files
- [mise.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/config/mise.toml): Mise tool configuration (tools, tasks, settings) - **SOURCE OF TRUTH**
- [main.pkl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/config/main.pkl): Pkl configuration source (generates mise.toml)
- [starship.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/config/starship.toml): Shell prompt configuration
- [pixi.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/pixi.toml): Conda-forge dependencies
- [.mcp.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/.mcp.json): MCP server configuration

### Dotfile Templates
- config/chezmoi/dot_zshrc.tmpl: Zsh configuration template
- config/chezmoi/dot_gitconfig.tmpl: Git configuration template
- config/chezmoi/.chezmoi.toml.tmpl: Chezmoi configuration

---

## Tool Hierarchy

### Level 1: Mise (Orchestrator)
**Purpose**: Global tool version manager & orchestrator  
**Install**: `curl https://mise.run | sh`  
**Config**: `~/.config/mise/config.toml`

### Level 2: Bun (JavaScript/TypeScript)
**Purpose**: JavaScript runtime (replaces Node.js/npm)  
**Install**: `mise use -g bun`  
**Speed**: 3x faster package installation than npm

### Level 3: Pixi (Binary Packages)
**Purpose**: Conda-forge packages & binary isolation  
**Install**: `mise use -g pixi`  
**Ecosystem**: 20,000+ packages from conda-forge

### Level 4: Uv (Python Packages)
**Purpose**: Fast Python package manager (10x faster than pip)  
**Install**: `mise use -g uv`  
**Speed**: 10x faster package resolution

---

## Tool Catalog

### Core Runtimes
- **bun**: JavaScript/TypeScript runtime (replaces Node.js)
- **pixi**: Conda-forge package manager
- **uv**: Fast Python package manager
- **node**: Node.js runtime (managed by mise)
- **usage**: CLI usage documentation generator
- **pkl**: Type-safe configuration language
- **pitchfork**: Development daemon manager

### Modern CLI Utilities
- **starship**: Cross-shell prompt
- **ripgrep**: Fast grep alternative (rg)
- **fd**: Fast find alternative
- **zoxide**: Smart cd command (z)
- **ast-grep**: AST-based code search (sg)
- **mgrep**: AI-assisted code search
- **bat**: Cat with syntax highlighting
- **eza**: Modern ls replacement
- **fzf**: Fuzzy finder
- **jq**: JSON processor
- **yq**: YAML processor
- **delta**: Git diff viewer

### Infrastructure & Cloud
- **1password-cli**: 1Password CLI (op)
- **github-cli**: GitHub CLI (gh)
- **skypilot**: Cloud orchestration (sky)
- **orbstack**: Docker/Linux on macOS

### AI Agents
- **@google/gemini-cli**: Gemini CLI
- **@ralph-orchestrator/ralph-cli**: Ralph orchestrator
- **claude-code**: Claude Code CLI
- **opencode-ai**: OpenCode AI CLI

### Development Tools
- **chezmoi**: Dotfile manager
- **gum**: Shell script UI components
- **bats**: Bash testing framework
- **shellcheck**: Shell script linter

## Testing

### Test Suite (254 tests)
- tests/test_mise.bats: Mise installation, backends, tasks
- tests/test_tools.bats: CLI tool availability
- tests/test_chezmoi.bats: Dotfile template validation
- tests/test_starship.bats: Prompt configuration
- tests/test_integration.bats: End-to-end project structure
- tests/test_ide_configs.bats: IDE/editor configuration tests
- tests/test_skypilot.bats: SkyPilot cloud agent tests
- tests/test_unified_setup.bats: Platform tasks, config_root, DevContainer
- tests/test_env_status.bats: env:status task output validation
- tests/test_noninteractive_skills.bats: Claude Code skill validation
- tests/test_setup.bats: Bootstrap script validation, spec compliance

### Running Tests
```bash
# Run all tests
bats tests/

# Run specific test file
bats tests/test_mise.bats

# Quick validation
mise run validate
```

### OpenSpec Workflow Commands

Each platform has 10 commands for the OpenSpec workflow:

| Command | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| explore | Think and investigate without making changes |
| new | Create a new OpenSpec change |
| ff | Fast-forward to tasks (skip proposal/design) |
| apply | Apply change to codebase |
| continue | Continue working on existing change |
| verify | Verify change completeness |
| archive | Archive completed change |
| bulk-archive | Archive multiple changes |
| sync | Sync specs with changes |
| onboard | Onboard new OpenSpec project |

## Critical Rules (NEVER BREAK)

1. **NEVER use sudo** - Everything is user-space
2. **NEVER install globally with npm/pip** - Use mise (`mise use -g`)
3. **NEVER modify system Python/Node** - Mise manages versions
4. **NEVER commit secrets** - Use op://, infisical, or mise secrets
5. **NEVER suppress type errors** - No `as any`, `@ts-ignore`
6. **ALWAYS use mise tasks** - Not raw commands (`mise run validate`)
7. **ALWAYS run tests before committing** - `bats tests/`
8. **ALWAYS check mise doctor after issues** - `mise doctor`
9. **PREFER existing patterns** - Check existing code first
10. **ASK if uncertain about scope** - Don't assume
11. **ALWAYS install CLI tools via mise** - Never `curl | sh`, `npm -g`, or direct downloads

---

## Common Commands

```bash
# Environment health
mise doctor
mise run validate
mise run tools:status

# Tool management
mise use -g <tool>              # Install tool globally
mise use -g "npm:<package>"     # Install npm package via Bun
mise use -g "pipx:<package>"    # Install Python CLI via Uv
mise which <tool>               # Show tool path

# Testing
bats tests/                     # Run all tests
mise run lint                   # Lint shell scripts

# Cloud agents
mise run agent:up               # Launch AWS agent
mise run agent:status           # Check agent status
mise run agent:down             # Terminate agent

# Updates
mise run tools:update           # Update all tools
mise upgrade                    # Update mise itself
```
